# Step 1: extract all movie titles in Simple Note notes where the listed director is David Fincher
simple_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password='RluCyXn')['access_token']

# Find all notes matching 'David Fincher'
notes=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_token, query='David Fincher', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'returned', len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    notes.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total notes', len(notes))
for n in notes:
    print('note_id', n['note_id'], 'title', n['title'], 'updated_at', n['updated_at'])

fincher_titles=[]
seen=set()

for n in notes:
    content = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=simple_token, note_id=n['note_id'])['content']
    # Parse: set current_title whenever we see a non-empty line that doesn't start with '-' or '#'
    current_title=None
    for line in content.splitlines():
        s=line.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if s.startswith('#'):
